title: A2UI MCP Catalog
description: A2UI catalog for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. It defines the `callMcpTool` function and the `McpApp` component that renders a sandboxed MCP App connected to the host through the MCP Apps bridge.

McpApp.description: Renders a sandboxed Model Context Protocol application using double-iframe isolation. The application talks to the host over the MCP Apps JSON-RPC bridge; tool calls it is allowed to make are dispatched as A2UI actions.

htmlContent.description: The HTML content of the app, rendered via srcdoc inside the sandbox. A value prefixed with `url_encoded:` is decoded with decodeURIComponent before rendering.

title.description: The title of the app, used as the accessible title of the frame.

allowedTools.description: The names of the MCP tools the app is allowed to call. The host dispatches an authorized `tools/call` request as an A2UI action named after the tool, with the tool arguments as its context, and rejects any other tool call.

allowedFunctions.description: A map of authorized host client function names to JSON Schemas describing their expected arguments. The host rejects a `ui/requests/function-call` request whose function is not listed or whose arguments fail validation. The functions must exist in the surface's catalog.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON Schema. The host validates the matching payload against it before acting on the message; an empty object accepts any value.

data.description: Data binding configuration for the component. Reserved keys `toolInput`, `toolResult`, and `modelContext` map to standard MCP Apps `ui/notifications/tool-input`, `ui/notifications/tool-result`, and `ui/update-model-context` messages.

paths.description: A dictionary mapping custom state keys (or reserved keys `toolInput`, `toolResult`, `modelContext`) to distinct JSON Pointer paths in the data model. The host pushes a `ui/notifications/data-model-update` notification whenever a bound value changes and writes authorized `ui/notifications/data-model-change` notifications back to the path.

csp.description: Per-resource Content Security Policy domain allowlists from `_meta.ui.csp`.

resourceDomains.description: Origins allowed for scripts, styles, images, fonts, and media.

permissions.description: Browser capability permissions delegated to the inner sandboxed iframe from `_meta.ui.permissions`.

camera.description: Delegates `camera` access via the iframe `allow` attribute.

microphone.description: Delegates `microphone` access via the iframe `allow` attribute.

geolocation.description: Delegates `geolocation` access via the iframe `allow` attribute.

clipboardWrite.description: Delegates `clipboard-write` access via the iframe `allow` attribute.

callMcpTool.description: Invokes a tool on a connected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and returns the result.

name.description: The name of the MCP tool to execute.

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the MCP tool.

targetDataPath.description: Optional JSON Pointer path on the surface data model where a resolved MCP App resource payload (`uri`, `htmlContent`, `csp`, `permissions`, `toolInput`, `toolResult`) is written.
